授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
* History and perspective
* Primary structure
* Chain dimension and solution properties
* Aggregation states
* Physical properties
* Gels
* Computational science
* Analytical method

Polymer Chemistry A and General Physical Chemistry must be completed.
Polymer synthesis and reactions and general thermodynamics
